title: Mycelia — Slime Mold Growth Studio
description: A real Physarum agent simulator — drop food, tune sensor physics, and watch vein networks grow toward it.
concept: A genuine diffusion-based Physarum (slime mold) agent simulation: thousands of independent agents sense trail concentration through three forward sensors and steer toward the strongest signal, depositing their own trail as they move, while the trail field diffuses and decays each frame. Tap anywhere to drop food sources that bias sensing and pull the growing network into branching veins toward them. Switch between 6 physics presets (Physarum, Coral, River, Neural, Bloom, Lattice), or flip on multi-species mode to run three rival colonies with tunable territorial rivalry that carve the canvas into competing regions.
features: 6 tunable colony presets with distinct sensor/turn/deposit physics (Physarum, Coral, River, Neural, Bloom, Lattice)
Multi-species mode: 3 simultaneous rival colonies with an adjustable rivalry slider that makes them compete for territory
Tap/click/drag to place food sources that redirect growth into branching vein networks in real time
Live physics sliders — sensor angle, sensor distance, turn speed, step size, deposit, decay, diffusion, simulation speed
6 color palettes plus food-glow and additive bloom toggles
Save-recipe gallery with thumbnail previews stored in localStorage, click to reload any past colony
Export current growth as a PNG snapshot, export the full recipe as downloadable JSON, and copy a shareable URL hash that reproduces the exact colony
Autosaves last-used settings to localStorage so a reload picks up where you left off
tech: Typed-array trail fields with separable box-blur diffusion

interaction.mouse: Click or drag on the canvas to drop food sources that pull vein growth toward them
interaction.click: Use the ⚙ controls sheet to switch presets, toggle multi-species mode, and tune physics/look sliders
interaction.touch: Tap or drag anywhere to place food; all sliders and buttons are touch-friendly on mobile
interaction.keyboard: Space toggles play/pause, R reseeds a new colony, S exports the current growth as PNG
